Professional Summary

Ph.D. researcher and academic professional with expertise in Antenna Design, RF/Microwave Engineering, 5G Wireless Communication, Digital Communication, and Renewable Energy Systems. Experienced in the design, simulation, optimization, and performance analysis of compact planar microstrip patch, monopole, Vivaldi, and MIMO antennas for 5G Sub-6 GHz and WLAN applications. Proficient in CST Studio Suite, HFSS, COMSOL Multiphysics, ADS, Tarang, MATLAB/Simulink, PVsyst, TRNSYS, and OriginPro. Strong research experience in electromagnetic simulation, antenna measurements, technical documentation, and research publication.
Ph.D. in Electronics & Communication Engineering
Eklavya University, Damoh (MP) 2026
Thesis: "Investigation and Design of Compact Planar Antenna for 5G Applications."

RF Microwave, Antenna and wave propagation, Analog and Digital Communication, wireless communication, Digital signal Processing, Solar photovoltaic energy and solar Thermal energy, Wind energy, control System, Optical Fiber Communication, Image Processing. Electronic Devices.
Technical Skills
Antenna & RF Engineering: Microstrip Patch, MIMO, Monopole and Vivaldi Antenna Design; 5G Sub-6 GHz, Wi-Fi/WLAN, RF and Microwave Applications.
Communication Systems: Digital & Wireless Communication, 4G/5G, Digital Modulation, OFDM, MIMO, Channel Coding, BER and Signal Analysis.
Renewable Energy: Solar Photovoltaic (PV) and Solar Thermal Systems, PV System Design, Solar Energy Conversion, Thermal Collectors and Performance Analysis.
Antenna & Communication Analysis: S-Parameters (S11), VSWR, Bandwidth, Gain, Directivity, Radiation Efficiency, ECC, DG, TARC and CCL.
Simulation & Design Software: CST Studio Suite, HFSS, COMSOL Multiphysics, MATLAB/Simulink, PVsyst, TRNSYS, OriginPro, Proteus and Multisim. ADS, Tarang
Experimental & Data Analysis: Electromagnetic Simulation, Antenna Measurement and Validation, Optimization, Data Analysis and Technical Documentation.
